author: Universal Pictures
description:
Joe (Jo Koy) and his mother Susan (Lydia Gaston) finally hash it out over years of guilt trips, a secret trip to Los Angeles, and the truth about why she pushed him so hard growing up. It all boils down to one memory, learning to ride a bike with two broken wrists, and by the end the whole family is back at the table, singing karaoke like nothing happened.
